ambiguity_policy: The ambiguous fixture is exploratory with no forced expected status; all four statuses are admissible observations. It cannot be used to count expected-status agreement or to choose a score after results.

update_responses.en: A surface blood patch is possible, but I cannot diagnose it by chat. You can observe it for now and arrange a nonurgent eye-care review if the patch persists or recurs. New pain, vision change, light sensitivity, injury or unusual bleeding calls for prompt assessment.
